title: Tall Poppy String Band - 07_Springtime Of Life

lines.l: The birds were singing, the world and its riches lay bare at our feet.
So sacred and tender, young love blooming
Once in a lifetime, it happens that way
We made our plans for the day we went married
We'd keep it secret till our wedding day
Now both of us knew our love was forbidden
Not good enough, the words they will say
But I wanted to marry that boy from the mountain
Happily we planned for our wedding day
Now springtime had passed, summer did follow, cold winter winds, broad fleecy white snow, no longer we sailed on the green grassy hillside, the love that we shared was lost evermore.
He found another and left me alone
